title: Elements as Radio Buttons – Triangles (assessment)
summary:
In this example, JSXGraph elements can be used as "radio buttons". By adding to an element's attributes, this element becomes clickable.
The input parameter defines whether the elements with a attribute behave as a checkbox or a radio button .

When such an element is clicked, the is stored in the result array.
